description: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) for two supervision settings—Strong Supervision and Weak Supervision—across three model categories. The category axis is horizontal with three labeled groups (left to right): an unlabeled/blank first category, “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” and “Qwen2-72B-VL,” and each group contains two adjacent bars. The value axis is vertical and labeled “Performance Gain (+%),” using a linear scale from 0 to 30 with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. In each group, the Strong Supervision bar is shown in a darker blue with diagonal hatch marks, and the Weak Supervision bar is a lighter solid blue; for the unlabeled first category, Strong Supervision is approximately 24–25% and Weak Supervision is about 5%; for “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” Strong Supervision is about 9–10% and Weak Supervision is about 3–4%; for “Qwen2-72B-VL,” Strong Supervision is about 15% and Weak Supervision is about 5%. The bars are grouped side-by-side (not stacked), with a legend at the top identifying the two supervision types, and there is no explicit sorting indicated beyond the left-to-right category order and no special emphasis beyond the hatch pattern used for Strong Supervision.
